name: Glean tool server v0.2 (front door + hosting)
when_to_use: Use when an AI should find and run Glean tools from plain words through one endpoint: do() to find, call() to run. Host it with --public for a shared URL that holds no data.

how_to_change.note: Stdlib only. Public mode must never load or write anyone's data. New capabilities belong in cells with a tools.json, not in the server.
